title: factdiff anchor --file takes either path form and proposes each fact's quote
goal: factdiff.py anchor --file accepts a path under kb/<root>/ as well as a root-relative one; a --quotes CSV may give a quote per cited source of a fact, as gate g1 decides; anchor --file F --propose prints, for each fact of F with no anchor row, the passage of each cited page that best holds it as a quote CSV line, writing nothing; anchoring one file rewrites no _anchors.csv or _fetch_state.csv row of another topic; the anchor part of test_live_kb.py proves each on a planted article (no new test id)
